reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval

sources.title: Enveda: Phase 1 ENV-308 results and planned post-GLP-1 study
requiredTerms: not approved for use by any regulatory authority
sources.assessment: Enveda reports Phase I safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic and exploratory leptin observations in 88 healthy adult volunteers. The company explicitly says the study was not designed to detect body-weight or metabolic outcomes and that weight, body-composition and maintenance effects are for future trials. Lean-muscle preservation and prevention of weight regain are preclinical findings, not demonstrated human benefits. Phase II post-GLP-1 maintenance research is planned, not initiated or completed in this source.

registrySearch.assessment: No exact-name ClinicalTrials.gov record was returned. A separate sponsor search returned four Enveda records, all for ENV-294 rather than ENV-308. Registry absence does not disprove the sponsor-reported Phase I study, but it prevents independent confirmation of its registration, locations, formal status, dates and outcomes from this registry.

proposal.name: ENV-308
proposal.summary: Enveda describes ENV-308 as an investigational once-daily oral small molecule designed to mimic Lac-Phe and support weight and metabolic maintenance after GLP-1 treatment. The reported first-human study assessed safety, tolerability and drug behaviour in healthy volunteers; it did not test weight loss, body composition or post-GLP-1 maintenance. A Phase II maintenance study is planned.
proposal.ukAuthorisation: The sponsor says ENV-308 is not approved by any regulatory authority; no UK marketing authorisation is established.
proposal.nhsEngland: No NHS access is established by the reviewed evidence.
proposal.supply: No lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock is established. Early clinical research is not supply.
proposal.limitations: Human evidence is limited to the sponsor's Phase I summary in healthy volunteers. Human weight-maintenance, body-composition and lean-mass outcomes have not been demonstrated in the reviewed evidence, Phase II is only planned, and no matching ClinicalTrials.gov record was found.

retrievalFailures.detail: Exact-name and sponsor record searches did not return an ENV-308 trial. Formal registry identifiers, locations and status remain unverified.

nextAction: Editorially decide whether this distinct post-GLP-1 maintenance and muscle-preservation programme belongs in the live research summaries. If authorised, configure the sponsor announcement for monitoring, preserve the missing-registry limitation, and do not present preclinical lean-mass findings as human evidence or Phase II plans as completed activity.
